purpose: Document first-party discovery, viewer/service evidence, bounded anonymous requests, safe fields, and coverage limits for Pasto.
assessment: The official Alcaldía de Pasto Geoportal exposes an ArcGIS Feature Layer for Predios urbanos. Its metadata identifies polygon geometry, EPSG:3115 source CRS, native codigo_predial_nacional identity, and IGAC attribution. A bounded anonymous geometry-only query returned three full polygons, and an exact-point identity-only query returned one native identity.
registryAssessment: The Alcaldía de Pasto is the local geoportal custodian evidenced here; IGAC is the attributed national cadastral source. This establishes a local public cadastral/map service, not a guarantee of current citywide completeness or unrestricted registry access.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Pasto ArcGIS service lists urban and rural parcel layers and advertises JSON/GeoJSON query formats.
Official urban parcel layer metadata: polygon geometry, EPSG:3115, codigo_predial_nacional field, IGAC copyright attribution, public query capability.
Official IGAC page describes open cadastral geospatial/alfanumeric products and its cadastral data role.
Official IGAC guidance describes cadastral consultation by map, coordinates, address, or parcel number; no unsafe fields were requested here.

viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: Layer 29 is esriGeometryPolygon with sourceSpatialReference WKID 3115; outSR=4326 GeoJSON was accepted. Native identity field is codigo_predial_nacional (30-character string).

attempts.result: HTTP 200; service metadata listed parcel layers 17, 29, 34, 35, 42, and 43 and GeoJSON support.

HTTP 200; schema inspected. Layer is polygonal, source CRS EPSG:3115, public query-capable, and exposes codigo_predial_nacional as the native identity field. Unsafe fields were not requested in feature queries.
HTTP 200; three complete Polygon features returned with only codigo_predial_nacional and geometry. Response indicated exceededTransferLimit=true; only three were retained.

HTTP 200; one native identity returned: 520010102000001980017000000000. Geometry intentionally omitted. Exact point was used unchanged in longitude,latitude request encoding from the required latitude,longitude WUP record.

geometryDecision: Retained exactly one sample GeoJSON with three full polygons; each feature properties object contains only the canonical native id.

geometryEvidence.query: Layer 29 bounded first-three query with outFields=codigo_predial_nacional, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Pasto Geoportal municipality parcel layers, with Layer 29 urban parcel evidence.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous public schema, native IDs, exact-point ID response, and three geometry responses verified.

remainingUncertainty: No independent proof of data currency, full citywide transfer, municipal boundary equivalence, or rural-layer schema was obtained. A successful exact-point hit and three arbitrary sample features do not prove complete coverage.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A real anonymous ID-plus-geometry response exists, but serial reviewer qualification is still required before adapter/runtime readiness.
